schema.description: Curated, versioned list of Stellar protocol upgrade windows and scheduled testnet resets. Current protocol versions are shown from live ledger headers; the referenceProtocolVersions map below is only a last-verified fallback for networks with no live ledger available.

fieldNotes.lastUpdated: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the curated entries were last reviewed by a maintainer.
fieldNotes.referenceProtocolVersions[network].versi: Integer protocol version read from that network's Horizon ledger header at lastVerified.
fieldNotes.upgrades[].activationDate: ISO date, or null when the exact date is unknown.
fieldNotes.upgrades[].activationWindow: Estimated { start, end } ISO dates, or null when no window is known.
fieldNotes.upgrades[].dateConfidence: One of: confirmed | estimated | unknown. Never present an estimated date as confirmed.
fieldNotes.upgrades[].caps[].assignment: confirmed when the CAP index maps the CAP to this protocol version, tbd when it is only a candidate.
fieldNotes.testnetResets[].scheduledFor: ISO date, or null when the reset has not been announced yet.

upgrades.dateNote: No SDF activation date was announced as of 2026-09-26. This window is the maintainer's estimate; replace activationDate/dateConfidence once the Core team confirms the vote.
upgrades.title: Protocol 29 (in development on Futurenet)
upgrades.summary: Futurenet already reports protocol 29 in its ledger headers while Mainnet and Testnet remain on 28. Treat protocol 29 as upcoming and test against Futurenet before it activates on Testnet.
impacts: New host functions may ship in this version; re-run Soroban contract tests against Futurenet.
Consensus timing and resource limits can change, so hard-coded fee or TTL assumptions should be re-checked.
CAP numbers listed here are candidates only until the CAP index assigns them to protocol 29.
upgrades.capsNote: The CAP index does not yet map any CAP to protocol 29, so the entries below are TBD-status candidates and are not guaranteed to ship in this version.

caps.title: Host functions for ML-DSA signature verification

upgrades.dateNote: Already active on Mainnet and Testnet as of the last verification. This dataset does not record the original activation day.
upgrades.title: Protocol 28 (active)
upgrades.summary: Protocol 28 is the protocol version currently reported by Mainnet and Testnet ledger headers. It adds validator-controlled transaction set dropping, externally managed contract executables, and Symbol-keyed host functions.
impacts: Validators can vote to drop the current transaction set; retry logic should tolerate a dropped closed ledger.
Externally managed contract executables change how large Wasm is uploaded and referenced by contracts.
New Symbol-keyed map host functions reduce the cost of building keyed contract data.

caps.title: Allow validators to vote to drop the transaction set from the current ledger
Host functions for sparse Symbol-keyed map creation and unpacking

testnetResets.dateNote: Estimated to fall inside the Protocol 29 rollout window. Testnet resets are announced shortly beforehand; update scheduledFor and set dateConfidence to confirmed once SDF publishes the notice.
testnetResets.summary: A Testnet reset is expected around the Protocol 29 rollout. Everything on Testnet is wiped: account balances, trustlines, deployed Soroban contracts, and stored contract data will not survive.
impacts: Re-fund accounts from Friendbot and recreate trustlines.
Redeploy Soroban contracts and re-run any initialization or seeding scripts.
Refresh saved contract IDs and transaction hashes in local configs.
